reason: A ties the graduation claim to checks the board can actually run: yearly reporting on first-period tardies, attendance, course failures and the graduation rate. It also tells the board to ask the neighboring district how it handled sports before the vote. For a reader who has heard the athletic director's objections, that is more convincing. B is warmer, but it brings in sleep figures that weren't among the writer's facts and says sleep loss affects "nearly all" students when the survey shows about 72%.
